items.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
items.description: Mokha's capture would bring the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait waterway, a key shipping route.

items.title: Yemen: Houthis take control of strategic Red Sea port city
items.description: The Houthi takeover of Mokha comes amid intensified fighting that has sparked fears of a return to civil war. The Red Sea has served as a key alternative to the Strait of Hormuz amid the US war with Iran.

items.title: Are electric vehicles really bad for the environment?
items.description: Some German politicians are calling for a delay to the EU plan to phase out gas-powered vehicles, saying cars must be judged on the entire carbon footprint. But the full picture still says EVs are more climate friendly.

items.title: Serbia, the conflicted EU candidate
items.description: On paper, Belgrade has pursued EU membership for years. But accession has long been stalled. The hero's farewell given to war criminal Mladic exposed just how far Serbia has alienated itself from Europe.

items.title: Europe needs to compete in spaceflight, says France's Macron
items.description: The French president called for setting goals like European cargo missions, lunar landings, and crewed spaceflight while urging the bloc to reduce its reliance on US and Russia.
